Card Q&A.q: Can I place either my Digimon or an opponent's Digimon as the top security card for this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect?

Effect: When any of your [Ver.1] trait Digimon would digivolve into this card, reduce the digivolution cost by 2.
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By trashing this Digimon's bottom face-down digivolution card, place 1 Digimon with as much or less DP as this Digimon as the top security card.
